text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous! It delights me to see your<n>ongoing
efforts and another spirited<n>training session!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore! I thought I would bring you<n>a little
something to show my thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hands me a gift that looks quite<n>expensive.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A tasty selection of morsels! Yes, the<n>finest of iced
creams!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I hope this will help relieve some of<n>your fatigue
from training in the<n>scorching heat every day!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Do keep this a secret from Tazuna, if<n>you would.
Solemnly swear it!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And with that, I shall take my leave!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is indeed some of the best ice<n>cream we've ever
had. Pure<n>melt-in-your-mouth goodness!
